extraction_notes: No R program, Ecosim or SPPR executed. Canonical input preserves known persisted parameter values and directly deposited biological estimates only for missing fields; raw config literals in companions.

Rpath_parameter_model.csv.description: All persisted Rpath.parameters$model cells; Type 0 consumer 1 producer 2 detritus 3 fleet; Biomass t/km2 whole model area; PB QB /year; ProdCons EE Unassim and detritus routing fractions; BioAcc DetInput and fleet removals t/km2/year; native unknowns preserved blank.

Rpath_parameter_diet.csv.description: All persisted literal Rpath.parameters$diet cells; prey rows consumer columns including producer placeholder column; Import is an external dietary fraction. No normalization.

Rpath_pedigree.csv.description: Persisted Rpath pedigree cells; software initialized values are preserved as native evidence and do not confer researcher confidence.

Rpath_stanza_groups.csv.description: All persisted stock-level stanza values; VBGF_Ksp /year, Wmat relative mass, BAB /year, last age months, R model-scaled recruitment; software defaults and source-derived outputs remain native evidence.

Rpath_stanza_individuals.csv.description: All persisted stage-level stanza values; First Last months, Z /year, Leading boolean, Biomass t/km2, Cons t/km2/year, QB /year. No stanza equations were rerun.

Source_config_vectors.csv.description: Every literal Ecopath configuration vector before check.rpath.params, expanded c()/rep() without executing R; decimal spelling and NA missingness retained.
